blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.purpose: Compressed, not skipped. Phonetics and core grammar.

blocks.name: Exam conversion
blocks.purpose: Timed sections, TCF task formats, error repair.

blocks.name: Mocks and taper
blocks.purpose: Full mocks, then taper into 12 Feb.

weeks.focus: **Phonetics only.** Nasal vowels, *tu* vs *tout*, the R. Shadow daily. No grammar. **Book one 30-min tutor session as an assessment.**
Phonetics + liaison/elision. Present tense, être/avoir, articles, gender. Anki properly.
Regular -er/-ir/-re, negation, questions. Tutor 2×/week. Question-formation drills.
Passé composé. Everyday vocabulary.
**Start registration watch** (2027 calendars publish Nov–Dec). Tutor to 5×/week. Imparfait + PC/imparfait contrast.
Futur proche/simple. Object pronouns. Writing 3×/week, marked.
Subjonctif présent. *Journal en français facile*.
Relative pronouns. Opinion and argument language.
Conditionnel. *InnerFrench* with transcript.
Comparison, cause/consequence connectors. 3-min prepared monologues.
Plus-que-parfait, reported speech. Writing to 180 words. **Register the day the 2027 calendar opens.**
Passive, impersonal, formal register. *1jour1actu* → RFI (français facile exercises).
Abstract topics (TCF essay themes). Full untimed mock.
**Deliberate catch-up week.** Begin format shift: timed CO/CE.
*Expression écrite* tâches 1–3 to template. Four marked pieces.
*Expression orale* tâches 1–3 with tutor daily. Timed mock CO/CE.
Error-log week.
Speed work: comprehension at 1.25×, writing to time, unprepared speaking.
**Full timed mock under exam conditions.** No new Anki cards. **GO / DEFER**
Second mock. Repair only the weakest ability.
Taper. Light listening/speaking, error-log read-through. Rest Thursday.

hours: ~645 planned, ~570 realistic once weekend shifts are accounted for. Target for low B2 from a standing start is 500–600. Adequate, not generous.

daily.note: From Block B on, **production takes over 40%** — because the lowest ability decides the result.

engine.job: **Recovery. No new grammar.** Anki, listening, shadowing. Any tutor slot today is pure repetition, never new production.
**New structure #1.** Introduce, drill, use. Tutor: forced production of exactly this.
**Consolidate.** Same structure, new contexts. Marked writing.
**Review + spiral** — this week, *plus* a deliberate return to two weeks ago. Marked writing. Tutor.
Anki + listening. Nothing needing a desk.
Anki + listening + read the error log. **No production.**

rules: **New material enters Tuesday to Thursday only.** A structure introduced on a post-call Monday will not survive.
**Weekends are input by design, not by failure.** Saturday and Sunday are Anki and listening — roughly a third of the weekly load, doing real work.
**Friday spirals.** Return to two weeks ago every Friday, or January leaves you with twelve half-known structures instead of six solid ones.
**Never do paid contract work during a clinical shift.** Production (tutor, marked writing, timed mocks) goes on weekday evenings.
**Do not change the timetable structure.** Placement can change; the grid stays.

gates.pass: 3–5 min conversation without switching to English · ~900 words · passé composé accurate in speech · pronunciation not fossilising · movement vs week 1 assessment
gates.miss: Add two weeks to Block A, book the April sitting

gates.pass: InnerFrench at 1.0× with transcript · ~2,000 words · 120 words in 20 min · 3 min prepared speech
gates.miss: Usually too little listening — add an hour daily for two weeks

gates.pass: CO ≥400 and CE ≥400 on a TCF sample · 180-word piece at ~9/20 · 3 min unprepared
gates.miss: Production only: normal, Block C fixes it. Comprehension: move to April

gates.pass: **CO ≥458, CE ≥453** on a timed mock · EE tâche 2 at 10/20 · EO tâche 3 sustained
gates.miss: One ability short: continue. Two or more: defer to April

overriding: Do not sit the exam until a full mock clears **all four** thresholds with margin. One attempt at ₦750k.
wellbeing: At each gate: is sleep holding · has the Anki streak broken 3+ days · have I skipped paid tutor sessions? **Pre-committed rule:** if two of three appear, cut micro1 to the 10-hour minimum and move the TCF to April. No renegotiating in the moment.
money: Fee needs **₦44k/week banked** from now to mid-January — essentially all disposable income.
Tutoring (~₦19k/week lean) must come from contract income (micro1, ~$40/hr, 10 hrs/week minimum, capped at 10 hrs until 13 Feb).

**Decision point Monday 16 November (week 9):** if the fee fund is under ₦400k or no contract income has landed, move to the **March or April sitting**. A March result still clears the 23 May birthday.

structure: 3 tâches: T1 informal message (60–120 words) · T2 semi-formal recount + opinion (120–150) · T3 compare two opposing documents and argue (120–180)

3 tâches: T1 entretien dirigé — the examiner asks about you (~2 min, no prep) · T2 exercice en interaction — YOU ask 10–12 questions about a document, examiner plays the seller (~5½ min incl. 2 min prep) · T3 expression d'un point de vue — defend an opinion, no notes (~4½ min)
tcf.fee: ₦700,000–750,000 (₦700k for AF/IFN students with 180 hrs in 12 months). One realistic attempt.
tcf.results: 15 working days from receipt; ~10 if computer-delivered (Lagos runs E-TCF). Realistically 2–4 weeks.
tcf.remark: From TCF sessions of 1 September 2026, requests to re-mark the speaking and writing papers are no longer accepted, for roughly one year. That window covers 12 February 2027. Verify with the centre.
tcf.correction: Correction to the handoff: the handoff lists speaking task 1 as "you interview the examiner". On the real TCF Canada, task 1 is the examiner interviewing you and task 2 is you asking the questions. The ten question frames still matter — they now score in tâche 2.
